Class Schedule.Literal

jakarta.enterprise.util.AnnotationLiteral<Schedule>
jakarta.enterprise.concurrent.Schedule.Literal
All Implemented Interfaces:

public static final class Schedule.Literal extends jakarta.enterprise.util.AnnotationLiteral<Schedule> implements Schedule
Enables instances of the Schedule annotation to be created at run time.

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static Schedule.Literal of(String cron, Month[] months, int[] daysOfMonth, DayOfWeek[] daysOfWeek, int[] hours, int[] minutes, int[] seconds, long skipIfLateBy, String zone)
      Construct a new instance of the Schedule annotation.
      Parameters:
      cron - Cron expression following the rules of CronTrigger. Empty string to disregard.
      months - Months in which the method aims to run. Empty to disregard.
      daysOfMonth - Days of the month (1 to 31) on which the method aims to run. Empty to disregard.
      daysOfWeek - Days of the week on which the method aims to run. Empty to disregard.
      hours - Hours of the day (0 to 23) at which the method aims to run. Empty to disregard.
      minutes - Minutes (0 to 59) at which the method aims to run. Empty to disregard.
      seconds - Seconds (0 to 59) at which the method aims to run. Must not be empty.
      skipIfLateBy - Seconds after which an execution that is late to start should be skipped instead of starting late.
      zone - Time zone id, such as America/Chicago, of the schedule. Empty string indicates the default time zone.
      Returns:
      a new instance of the Schedule annotation.
